title: Rubio says Quad leaders meeting in Manila to be announced soon
summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday that a Quad leaders meeting in Manila, Philippines, will "hopefully" be announced very soon.

blocks.text: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio at the State Department in Washington, D.C., February 10, 2025. REUTERS/ Craig Hudson/ File photo
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday that a Quad leaders meeting in Manila, Philippines, will "hopefully" be announced very soon.
Rubio was speaking at a press conference in Atlanta after meeting his counterparts from the other Quad nations of Japan, Australia and India. —Reuters
